previous_evidence.excerpt: Parent-teacher meeting ran late. Most parents didn't show up, same as last month. Spent the rest of the evening marking notebooks and helping Amma sort the kitchen.

Went to the literacy camp in Sultanpur today and I keep thinking about this one girl, maybe seven or eight, who was holding the pencil like she'd never held one before. And honestly she probably hadn't. She was gripping it...

current_evidence.excerpt: Interesting thing happened during morning assembly. One of my Class 3 students, Ravi, came up to me after and said he told his mother about the water pollution lesson I did last week. She apparently asked him to explain it...
